fullContentHtml:
BHEL Artisan Grade-IV Recruitment 2026 – Full Notification Details

Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL), a premier Maharatna Public Sector Enterprise, has announced notification (Advt. No. 01/2026) for 660 vacancies of Artisan Grade-IV. The recruitment drive is open for candidates possessing 10th pass qualification along with ITI (NTC) and National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) in relevant trades including Fitter, Welder, Machinist, Electrician, Turner, and Foundryman.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 21 October 2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online : 18 November 2026
  • Last Date for Fee Payment : 18 November 2026
  • CBT Exam Date : 11 December 2026 (Tentative)
  • Admit Card : 7 to 10 days before the exam

Application Fee

  • UR, EWS, OBC candidates : Rs. 1,072/-
  • SC, ST, PwD, Ex-Servicemen : Rs. 472/-
  • Payment mode : Online payment via Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking or UPI.

Age Limit (As on 01 October 2026)

  • Minimum Age : 18 Years
  • Maximum Age (General / EWS) : 27 Years
  • Maximum Age (OBC NCL) : 30 Years
  • Maximum Age (SC / ST) : 32 Years

Vacancy Distribution (Total: 660 Posts)

  • Fitter : 278 Posts
  • Welder : 104 Posts
  • Machinist : 101 Posts
  • Electrician : 90 Posts
  • Turner : 52 Posts
  • Electronics Mechanic : 23 Posts
  • Foundryman : 12 Posts

How to Apply Online for BHEL Artisan Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official BHEL careers recruitment website at careers.bhel.in.
  2. Click on the notification link for 'Artisan Grade-IV Recruitment 2026 (Advt 01/2026)'.
  3. Complete One Time Registration by providing your Name, Mobile Number, and Active Email ID.
  4. Fill out the detailed application form selecting your preferred manufacturing unit and single trade.
  5. Upload scanned copies of 10th mark sheet, ITI certificate, NAC certificate, category certificate, and passport photograph.
  6. Submit the applicable application fee through the online gateway and print the final confirmation page.

Important Links

  • Apply Online
  • Download Official Notification
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is the last date to apply for BHEL Artisan Recruitment 2026?

The last date to register and submit the online application form is 18 November 2026.

What is the minimum qualification required?

Candidates must have passed 10th standard and possess both National Trade Certificate (NTC/ITI) and National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) in the relevant trade with minimum 60% marks (55% for SC/ST).

What is the monthly stipend/salary during training?

Selected candidates will receive consolidated wages of Rs. 24,000/- per month during the one-year temporary period, following which they will be placed in the regular pay scale of Rs. 29,500 – Rs. 65,000/-.
